_readme: Real testimonials only, published with each person's permission. An entry shows only when 'published' is true. type must be one of: student | customer | partner. Write quotes WITHOUT quotation marks. 'image' is a path WITHOUT extension (no leading slash); loader requests .avif, .webp and .jpg. Omit 'image' to show initials.

testimonials.name: Dan Reynold Ogah
testimonials.quote: The Academy transformed me from a dreamer into a maker. Today I run my own workshop, take bespoke commissions, and build every pair properly, as I was taught.

testimonials.name: Poki Lengshimwa
testimonials.quote: Enterprise & Brand gave me the business side of shoemaking: pricing, marketing, dealing with clients. What used to be a passion is now how I pay my bills.

testimonials.name: Audu Solomon
testimonials.quote: Enterprise & Brand gave me the framework to run a footwear business, not just a bench. Pricing, positioning, and planning for export are the areas I lean on most.

testimonials.name: Jaga Nsan
testimonials.quote: I arrived with no workshop experience at all. Foundation Craft taught me how to cut cleanly, stitch evenly, and finish a pair without shortcuts. Those habits stuck with me.

testimonials.name: Ocha Okrie
testimonials.quote: The mentorship was specific and practical. I learned more in six weeks than in years of self-study, and the focus on sustainable leather shaped the brand I now run.

testimonials.name: James Happiness
testimonials.quote: From pattern making to business setup, the academy covered what I needed. Enterprise & Brand taught me how to price my work, handle clients, and run my own workshop.

testimonials.name: Paul Kufre
testimonials.quote: ModeInfinity Academy gave me the discipline and the standard. The teaching is direct, patient, and grounded in real work, not theory.

testimonials.name: Gideon Philip
testimonials.quote: Foundation Craft gave me the confidence to make shoes properly. We covered pattern drafting, leather selection, and hand stitching; everything I needed to build a pair from scratch.

testimonials.name: James Uzor
testimonials.quote: The advanced techniques and business mentorship at ModeInfinity are what I use every day. The standard I learned here is the standard I build to now.

testimonials.name: Customer Name
testimonials.quote: The fit, the finish, and the detail are immediately obvious. These are shoes made by someone who cares about what they do, and it shows the moment you put them on.

testimonials.name: Customer Name
testimonials.quote: I have commissioned three pairs now. The craftsmanship is consistent, the communication is clear, and the result always exceeds what I imagined.

testimonials.name: Customer Name
testimonials.quote: There is a real difference between footwear made by hand and footwear assembled by machine. ModeInfinity is clearly the former.

testimonials.name: Partner Name
testimonials.quote: Working with ModeInfinity has been straightforward and professional. They take the craft seriously and it shows in everything they deliver.

testimonials.name: Partner Name
testimonials.quote: The quality is consistent, the lead times are honest, and the brand carries itself well with our customers.
